parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.first().json || {}; const summary = data.summary || []; const posts = data.posts || []; const inactiveBrands = data.inactive_brands || []; const observations = data.observations || []; const postTypeSummary = data.post_type_summary || []; const reviewRecords = data.review_records || []; function safeNum(n) { return Number(n) || 0; } function esc(v) { return String(v ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"'); } function formatMMDate(dateStr) { if (!dateStr || dateStr === '-' || dateStr === 'undefined') return 'No Date'; return dateStr; } const filteredInactiveBrands = inactiveBrands.filter(b => !(b.reason && String(b.reason).includes('404'))); summary.sort((a, b) => safeNum(b.total_engagement) - safeNum(a.total_engagement)); const activeBrands = summary.filter(b => safeNum(b.total_views) > 0 || safeNum(b.total_engagement) > 0 || safeNum(b.post_count) > 0); const activeRows = activeBrands.map((b, i) => { const rankColors = ['#4f46e5', '#06b6d4', '#6366f1']; const rankColor = i < 3 ? rankColors[i] : '#64748b'; return ` ${i + 1} ${esc(b.brand_name)} ${safeNum(b.post_count)} ${safeNum(b.total_views).toLocaleString()} ${esc(b.engagement_rate)} ${safeNum(b.total_likes).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(b.total_comments).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(b.total_shares).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(b.total_saves).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(b.total_engagement).toLocaleString()} ${esc(b.dominant_post_type || '-')} `; }).join(''); const inactiveRows = filteredInactiveBrands.length > 0 ? filteredInactiveBrands.map(b => ` ${esc(b.brand_name)} ${esc(b.reason || 'No activity logged')} `).join('') : `All tracked brands posted this week.`; const reportTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: 'Asia/Yangon' }); const obsHTML = observations.length > 0 ? observations.map((o, i) => `
${i + 1}
${o}
`).join('') : `
No observations for this week.
`; const postTypeRows = postTypeSummary.length > 0 ? postTypeSummary.map((t, i) => ` ${esc(t.post_type)} ${safeNum(t.posts)} ${safeNum(t.views).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(t.saves).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(t.engagement).toLocaleString()} `).join('') : `No type data.`; const postRows = posts .filter(p => safeNum(p.views) > 0 || safeNum(p.engagement) > 0) .sort((a, b) => safeNum(b.views) - safeNum(a.views)) .map((p, i) => ` ${esc(p.brand_name)} ${esc(formatMMDate(p.postedAt))} ${esc(p.post_type || '-')} ${esc(p.content || '-')} ${safeNum(p.views).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(p.likes).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(p.comments).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(p.shares).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(p.saves).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(p.engagement).toLocaleString()} ${p.link ? `Watch` : '-'} `).join(''); const reviewRows = reviewRecords.slice(0, 10).map(r => ` ${esc(r.brand_name)} ${esc(r.reason)} ${esc(r.profile || '-')} `).join(''); const reportDate = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'Asia/Yangon' }); const html = `
GPS TRACKER MARKET · MYANMAR TIKTOK

📡 Social Radar

Weekly Strategic Intelligence Report • ${reportDate}

${posts.length}
TOTAL POSTS
${activeBrands.length}
ACTIVE BRANDS
${filteredInactiveBrands.length}
INACTIVE
${reviewRecords.length}
REVIEW

📊 Top Active Brand Performance

${activeRows}
Rank Brand Posts Views Eng. Rate Likes Comments Shares Saves Total Eng. Main Type
Glossary: • Eng. Rate: Total engagement divided by total views.• Total Eng.: Likes + Comments + Shares + Saves.

🎬 Content Type Distribution

${postTypeRows}
TypePostsViewsSavesEngagement

😶 No Activity Detected

${inactiveRows}
BrandStatus

📋 Weekly Observations

As of ${reportTime} MMT
${obsHTML}

🔍 Detailed Content Analysis (All Brands by Views)

${postRows}
BrandPosted (MMT)TypeContentViewsLikesCmtsSharesSavesEng.Link
Formula: Total Engagement = Likes + Comments + Shares + Saves.
${reviewRecords.length > 0 ? `

⚠️ Review Records

These are non-post/profile-level records returned by the scraper. They are not counted as posts, but are kept for checking.

${reviewRows}
BrandReasonProfile
` : ''}
GPS Tiktok Social Radar ${reportDate}
`; return [{ json: { subject: `📊 GPS Social Radar: TikTok Intelligence Report · ${reportDate}`, emailBody: html } }];
